<a id="header-manipulation"></a>
## Header manipulation

| Example | Language | Protocol | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| [add_header](go/extproc/examples/add_header/) | Go | `ext_proc-l7` | Injects request and response headers in a single pass. |
| [AddHeader](java/service-callout/src/main/java/example/AddHeader/) | Java | `ext_proc-l7` | Adds headers on both phases, controls route cache per phase. |
| [add_header](python/extproc/example/add_header/) | Python | `ext_proc-l7` | Adds a request header, clears route cache, removes a response header. |
| [normalize_header](python/extproc/example/normalize_header/) | Python | `ext_proc-l7` | Detects device type from :authority, injects a client-device header. |
| [update_header](python/extproc/example/update_header/) | Python | `ext_proc-l7` | Overwrites or adds headers via OVERWRITE_IF_EXISTS_OR_ADD. |

<a id="body-manipulation"></a>
## Body manipulation

| Example | Language | Protocol | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| [add_body](go/extproc/examples/add_body/) | Go | `ext_proc-l7` | Replaces request and response bodies with fixed values. |
| [AddBody](java/service-callout/src/main/java/example/AddBody/) | Java | `ext_proc-l7` | Appends to the request body, replaces the response body. |
| [add_body](python/extproc/example/add_body/) | Python | `ext_proc-l7` | Appends to the request body, replaces the response body. |
| [add_custom_response](python/extproc/example/add_custom_response/) | Python | `ext_proc-l7` | Replaces the response with a custom status, headers, and body. |
